recommendation: Prioritize **usability**, with **Too Many Ads** as the lead issue. Usability ranks first by severity sum, with 3,182 and 1,259 complaints [A2]. Within that area, Too Many Ads has 603 complaints and severity sum 1,301 [C9][C10], and reviews describe ads as frequent or excessive, including “One song one ad. Too much ad.” (review 79301447-1a7c-49ed-ac4e-b3b398dc65ea). This lead issue is supported by substantially more complaints than Confusing and Unreliable Playback Controls, which has 209 [C13], though controls have severity sum 608 [C14]. Billing/support is the strongest alternative area but ranks second, with severity sum 2,705 and 965 complaints [A4]. Its lead supplied issue, Basic Features Locked Behind Premium, has 665 complaints [C5]; one reviewer says they “can't even pick a certain song without Spotify premium” (review d146397f-4a94-4980-be00-ae9212eca3a7). Playback ranks third, with severity sum 2,205 and 657 complaints [A3]. Addressing ad frequency is a focused usability bet, not evidence of a promised retention or business outcome.

alternatives.why_not: Billing/support ranks second by area severity sum, not first [A4]. Basic Features Locked Behind Premium is a substantial alternative with 665 complaints [C5], but it is outside the recommended usability focus.
This is another usability candidate, but it has 209 complaints [C13] versus 603 for Too Many Ads [C9].
Playback ranks third by area severity sum [A3], with 657 complaints [A3]; Loading and Connection Problems has 145 complaints [C17].

limitations: These are aggregates of classified historical Google Play reviews, not a representative sample of all Spotify users; reviewers are self-selected public feedback.
Counts and severity sums do not establish causes, product impact, or business outcomes.
Cancellation language in reviews indicates stated intent, not observed churn.
General App Dissatisfaction does not support a specific product fix and is not recommended as an issue.
